name: print-social-grey-paper-mvp-home-dashboard-screen-post
title: MVP Guide Home Dashboard Post
whatItIs: A grainy grey post in a series with a tall condensed 'HOME / DASHBOARD' heading, orange subhead, explanatory copy and an orange-bezel phone showing a product home screen.
whatItMeans: The repeated layout makes a series easy to follow and the phone illustrates the advice instantly.
techniques: Series template: same header, subhead and phone placement each slide
Condensed heavy caps for the title
Orange subhead and bezel as unifying accent
Left text and right device balance
Footer creator card and save prompt

vocabulary.definition: A repeatable layout used across slides.
A coloured line under the title summarising the point.
A bar with the author's avatar, handle and save prompt.
